name: Assistant with tools
objective: One answer to a conversation so far, by a model that may use the ticked pipelines as its tools on the way: each use is a run of its own, under the same limits as the person's.

main.about: the model that answers and decides which tools to use

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.hint: A prompt kept in the library, put before the standing instructions.

contexts.label: Contexts
contexts.hint: Contexts kept in the library, added after the prompt.

skills.label: Skills
skills.hint: Skills kept in the library, added after the contexts: how to do the kinds of thing it may be asked.

tools.label: Pipelines it may use
tools.hint: Each ticked pipeline is a tool the model can call with that pipeline's inputs. Its runs are listed under this one.

rounds.label: Most rounds
rounds.hint: A round is one answer of the model, with the tool uses it asks for. When they run out, what it has so far is given.

written.label: Tool calls written into the text
written.hint: For a model or program without tool calling of its own: it is told how to write a call, and such calls are read from its answer.

projects.label: Work on projects (Muninn)
projects.hint: The project tools: read the projects its mask shows and propose changes, which wait for each project's owner. Works as agent:local for whoever started it.
